solver.interpretation: native CPU Newton solver/Euler/elliptic/dense; integer options checked against enum constants and actual mj_model.opt

common_scene.contacts: native MuJoCo-generated, no explicit pair, no Newton contacts

run.warmup: none; initial tiny overlap, all transient steps retained; Coulomb constant-N approximation scored from t=.05 with measured velocity as starting value, independent impulse balance scored from t0
run.sampling: state arrays include t0 and every output; step contact arrays represent forces used over pre-step n to post-step n+1. Read mj_contactForce immediately after solver.step without mj_forward, mj_step or backend mutation. Contact pos/frame correspond to force solve at pre-integration state; aggregate wrench about pre-step COM.

cases.title: 薄宽盒平面滑动：滑动摩擦系数单因素对照
cases.direct_intervention: body shape_material_mu only; plane mu=0 and equal priority expose elementwise maximum mixing
cases.reference: During sustained sliding v_x(t)=v_x(.05)-mu*g*(t-.05), x displacement trapezoidal/constant acceleration. Independent full trajectory impulse: m*(v_n-v_0)=sum_k dt*(F_contact_world[k]+m*g). Every force is native mj_contactForce not Newton CONTACT_F.

cases.title: 球体法线自旋：condim 3 与 4 的扭转摩擦作用
cases.direct_intervention: body mujoco.condim only; fixed torsional coefficient .002 m, plane condim3/torsion0 and equal priority. Sphere single point eliminates multi-point tangential-friction spin torque.
cases.reference: A has no torsion component and omega_z stays10. B while spinning: omega_z(t)=omega_z(.05)-mu_torsion*m*g/Izz*(t-.05). Independent angular momentum: Izz*(omega_z[n]-omega_z[0])=sum_k dt*tau_world_z_about_COM[k]. Verify torque opposing spin and actual enabled contact dim.

mixing_rule.same_priority: condim=max(geom_condim); each of3 friction components=max(geom pair); expand[slide,slide,torsion,roll,roll]; clamp each contact coefficient to mjMINMU=1e-5 even if component unused by condim.
mixing_rule.different_priority: Higher-priority geom supplies condim/friction; not varied here.
mixing_rule.solref_solimp: both identical rawvalues, identical priority andsolmix1 ensure no averaging ambiguity; verify actual compiled geom fields and percontactfields
mixing_rule.units: slide dimensionless; torsion and rolling coefficients metres. mj_contactForce returns force N then torque Nm in normal/tangent contact frame.
mixing_rule.scope: No explicit contact pairs, anisotropy, rolling condim6, GPU or Newton external contact path tested.

contact_observations: aggregate world force and torque about pre-step COM
force_sign_convention: mj_contactForce contact-frame wrench acts positive on geom2; invert for dynamic geom1. Transform each3-vector by frame.T. Torque about pre-step COM=contact torque + (contact_pos-preCOM) cross contact_force. Independent impulse balance must pass, otherwise reject evidence rather than choose a sign from outcomes.
physical_acceptance: All per-run physical gates and pair directional effect gates, with independent repeats. Negative outcomes are retained; no post-run gate changes. Exact source/backend/config/contact-mixing checks are evidence validity, separate from physics.
threshold_rationale: Expected sliding velocity separation .3*g*.3=.883m/s, paired gate.6; allowed .08m/s reference error tolerates initial soft normal transient but requires active sustained slip and little tilt. Expected spin loss .002*9.81/.004*.5=2.4525rad/s, paired gate1.5; .25rad/s reference tolerance plus independent torque/angular impulse excludes translation or rolling artefacts. Normal-ratio gates apply only t>=.05, all rawtransients retained.

native_source_refs.mechanism: mj_contactForce frame output and zeroing unused components
condim4 torsion and6 rolling; length units
